title: Readiness 2 · Shapes through boundary
prompt: Write ownersOf(input: unknown). If input is not an array, return "invalid". Otherwise return a Map from owner to the number of valid tasks they own, in first-seen order. A valid task is an object with kind "task" and a string id. owner is optional. Skip tasks without a string owner, but keep an empty owner string as its own owner. Skip anything else.
hints: Check the outer value with Array.isArray first.
For each item, rule out null and non-objects before reading fields.
Check kind, then the id type, then whether owner is a string. Empty text is a string.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty owner as missing.

feedback: A type alias cannot check data at runtime. Inspect each field before trusting it.
